I

Queen of Fate

She cannot enter the mortal realm. Her influence already has.

The sacred runes were scattered by Loki. From beyond the veil, the Disir Queen bends mortal fortune through her Guardian Beasts—and through armies small enough to escape notice.

“Wager your trinkets. Cast the runes. Answer to fate.”
II

The mortal game

Read the table.
Risk your fortune.

Across five rounds, players cast runes, command ants, invoke the Fate Bones, and score what the Queen allows. Round five brings the Bone Judgment—and fortune may turn on everything that came before.

A trinket changes hands

The winner claims glory. The loser signs the Scroll of Contrition and surrenders a trinket. The Queen watches what fortune makes of both.

5Rounds of play
7Rune stones cast
1Final judgment
III

Tools of fortune

Every piece carries a choice.

01

Cast the Runes

Wolf. Raven. Serpent. Bear. Stag. And Loki—the face that can kill a round.

02

Command the Ants

Spend them before the bone is drawn to reroll what fate has placed before you.

03

Invoke the Bones

Devour fate. Steal glory. Twist the cast. Hold fast. Or claim honor.

Beyond the mortal worlds

Enter Eldrim.

A moonlit fjord beneath a green aurora. Jagged peaks. A stone arch. A twisted tree. The Queen cannot cross into the mortal realm—but her hand is felt in every cast.
